bio.text: Rachel Wallace is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary; incumbent Dan Meuser is the Republican candidate.
According to the Republican Herald, she was born and raised in Pottsville, graduated from Pottsville Area High School, and began working for former Congressman Tim Holden early in her career.
She went on to work in the U.S. Senate and the State Department, and served as chief of staff at the White House Office of Management and Budget, the paper reported.
The article says she now lives in southern Schuylkill County.

sources.title: Pottsville native Rachel Wallace launches campaign for Congress
